svg.title: Large Text Compression Benchmark (enwik8), Mahoney-Kolmogorov N*, tufazip QPI1 Prior & 146 Proofs
svg.desc: Four-panel summary of Claims LA-76 through LA-79 and 146 six-kernel Lean 4.36.0 theorems (1510 Linux bwrap fleet): (A) Official Matt Mahoney Large Text Compression Benchmark enwik8 (100,000,000 bytes) lossless compression across Apple M5 Max, NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor (physical TI INA238 VIN shunt measured_j), and AMD Zen 5 RAPL with bit-exact cross-architecture archive SHA-256 identity; (B) Tufalabs/tufazip v2 QPI1 starter-prior transcoding (34,080,768 1-bit weights into exact 5,680,128 6-col LUT6 slabs, EntroMCU-28 -20% ternary cut, and Hadamard JouleBit-LUT6 starter priors) plus the Mahoney-Kolmogorov Compilation Threshold N*; (C) 144/144 Yosys abc -lut 6 Boolean miter and Cross-Silicon Window 25 Thor DC shunt telemetry (13.376x); and (D) 102.41 MHz XC7A200T openXC7 gateware, 15.22 KB 20-export lut6_core.wasm, and 146 six-kernel theorems (1510 fleet).
